sections.label: Cremated remains scattering options
sections.summary: Next-of-kin may place cremated remains in columbaria niches, at home or scatter at sea, and NEA is studying inland scattering sites.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For those who are cremated, their next-of-kin can choose to place the remains in niches at columbaria, keep them at home or scatter them at sea.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Apart from the scattering of cremated remains at sea, the National Environmental Agency (NEA) is studying the feasibility of designating sites for the scattering of cremated remains on land.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The NEA does not have plans to introduce burials at sea.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Inland ash scattering is done in countries like Hong Kong, Taiwan, China and Korea.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are studying the inland ash scattering concept and we are planning to offer this option of inland ash scattering at designated Government after-death facilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are consulting stakeholders, religious leaders as well as funeral parlour directors and so on, before we make an announcement later this year.

sections.label: Sea ash scattering site
sections.summary: A designated site about 1.5 nautical miles south of Pulau Semakau is provided for scattering ashes at sea, not sea burials.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Could the Senior Minister of State update us on that?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I do not have the numbers but my understanding is that the numbers have been pretty constant.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: There is a designated site, about 1.5 nautical miles south of Pulau Semakau, provided by Maritime Port Authority of Singapore for scattering of ashes at sea.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, just to clarify, when we talk about sea burials, we are talking about lowering the whole body into the sea.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: It is scattering of ashes at sea, which is allowed, but not sea burials.
